label: PF Backlog 543
title: C11: Kill switch (independent of the LLM) - stop workflow/agent/tool/schedule/deploy/connectors
body:
## Problem / why
No independent kill switch for autonomous execution.
## Acceptance criteria
An operator can halt workflow/agent/tool execution/scheduled runs/deployments/connectors without relying on the model; fail-closed; audited.
